description: This script is designed to analyze the boundaries and registrations of web search providers within a codebase. It scans project files, identifies references to web search provider implementations, and compares actual registration points against an expected inventory. The script involves file system operations, pattern matching within code lines, and exports functions related to inventory collection and validation.

methods.name: collectWebSearchProviderBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Asynchronously collects an inventory of web search provider boundary entries by scanning project files for relevant references and registrations.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads and parses the baseline inventory JSON file, returning an empty array if the file does not exist.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Compares expected and actual inventories and returns their differences.

methods.name: runWebSearchProviderBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs a check comparing the actual web search provider boundary inventory against the expected baseline, providing output via supplied IO.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for executing the boundary check script, handling process termination if IO is not supplied.
